title: Factory · Unwanted pings per merged MR

panels.title: Unwanted pings per merged MR (target → 0)
panels.description: plan_approval and final_review are wanted touchpoints; everything else is waste. Completed runs = merged MRs in the v1 flow.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(((SELECT count(*) FROM events WHERE type='ping_raised' AND payload->>'type' NOT IN ('plan_approval','final_review'))::numeric) / NULLIF((SELECT count(*) FROM events WHERE type='run_completed'),0), 2) AS unwanted_per_mr
SELECT payload->>'type' AS type, count(*) AS pings FROM events WHERE type='ping_raised' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT r.ticket_title AS run, r.state, count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.payload->>'type' IN ('plan_approval','final_review')) AS wanted, count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.payload->>'type' NOT IN ('plan_approval','final_review')) AS unwanted, string_agg(DISTINCT e.payload->>'type', ', ') AS types FROM runs r LEFT JOIN events e ON e.run_id=r.run_id AND e.type='ping_raised' GROUP BY r.run_id, r.ticket_title, r.state, r.created_at ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
